title: SSE heartbeat / ACK mismatch causing final-token loss and duplicated partial outputs
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Multiple paying customers reported production failures where Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams terminate without the final token, or clients receive duplicated partial outputs after an apparent reconnect. These manifest as truncated completions or repeated final sentences at the SDK layer. Customers are using hosted API in both single-region and cross-region setups; a small subset are on Dedicated. The pattern shows a heartbeat-ACK mismatch between gateways and downstream inference workers during transient network glitches, plus race conditions when we rehydrate KV caches and replay buffered chunks.
investigation_summary: Reproduced locally by throttling TCP and inducing micro-disconnects. Root cause hypothesis: gateway emits a heartbeat and then closes connection quickly if no ACK from worker arrives. The worker, when recovering, replays buffered chunks without the final 'eos' marker because that marker was emitted in-flight when connection dropped. Two issues combined: 1) lack of an explicit final-token/marker that survives reconnects and 2) ambiguous ACK semantics across the gateway <-> worker protocol leading to duplicate replay under slow ACK conditions.
impact_examples:
- Customer ACME Chat: several customer messages ended mid-sentence and were retried by their UI, producing duplicated trailing phrases.
- FinServ partner: truncation caused downstream validation failures for regulatory prompts.
- One Dedicated customer saw increased error budget due to repeated client retries.
repro_steps: 1) Start a long streaming completion with KV cache enabled. 2) Introduce a 200-500ms egress jitter on gateway -> worker path during generation. 3) Force gateway to close after sending heartbeat when no worker ACK arrives. 4) Observe client receives partial stream and subsequent reconnect yields duplicated chunks without final eos marker.
proposed_solution: 1) Add an explicit, idempotent final-token marker (event type: 'final_boundary') emitted from the runtime that is persisted to session checkpoint. 2) Tighten gateway <-> worker ACK semantics: require worker to ACK receipt of 'final_boundary' before gateway considers generation complete. 3) On reconnect, gateway consults session checkpoint and will not replay buffered chunks if final_boundary is present. 4) Add lightweight per-session monotonic sequence numbers for events to deduplicate replays on the client and at the gateway. 5) Backfill existing sessions by enabling a best-effort detection path that treats near-identical trailing chunks as possible duplicates and de-dupes at the gateway for a short window.
implementation_notes:
- Runtime change: emit 'final_boundary' token as a discrete SSE event.
- Gateway change: persist session checkpoints to redis with TTL(48h).
- Worker change: make ACK semantics durable; ACKs should be idempotent and include last-seen sequence number.
- SDK change: relax client-side retry heuristics to favor idempotent dedupe when final_boundary missing.
- Maintain compatibility: fallback to current behavior when private deployments have not upgraded; expose feature gate in routing policy.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for sequence numbering and checkpoint persistence.
- Integration test that simulates ACK delay and verifies final_boundary prevents truncation/duplication.
- Canary rollout: enable runtime/gateway changes in a single low-traffic region for 72h, monitor duplicate/truncate metrics.
- Add fuzz tests that randomly drop ACKs and verify at-most-once semantics in client-visible streams.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge runtime and gateway changes behind feature flag. 2) Deploy to staging and run the integration test suite. 3) Canary enable in us-west-2 for 72h. 4) Gradual rollout to hosted customers and Dedicated pools over two weeks. 5) For Private customers, ship patch notes and ops guidance; provide migration script to backfill checkpoints.
monitoring_and_alerting:
- New SLO beta metric: "stream_final_boundary_missing_rate".
- Alert P50 duplicate-token spikes > 0.5% over 5m.
- Dashboards: per-customer duplicate/truncate rates, average ACK latency gateway->worker, session checkpoint write failures.
- Pager escalation: P0 if any top-10 paying customer sees >1% truncation rate for 30m.
postmortem_actions:
- Ship final_boundary and sequence-number changes (this ticket).
- Audit other gateway protocols for ambiguous ACK semantics.
- Update client SDKs to use dedupe heuristics and expose final_boundary state to app developers.
- Create runbook for on-call to triage SSE partial-output reports.
- Schedule cross-team retro with Support + Sales to improve customer communications cadence.
customer_communications: Initial customer notifications sent 2026-03-09 by @support with mitigation guidance (short-term: increase client reconnect backoff to 250ms; disable aggressive UI retry). Follow-up sent 2026-03-12 with planned fix and ETA. Dedicated customer leads contacted directly for patch scheduling.
